visible.description:
This determines whether the option appears in the dropdown.
Since the metadata is defined in a base package, it's not possible to _delete_ the metadata in an upstream package.
Instead, this can be set to `false` to completely hide the model option.

disabled.description:
This determines whether the option in the dropdown should be disabled.
For marketing purposes, it could be advantageous to still show disabled options in the dropdown so
users can see what's available if they were to upgrade to an enterprise plan, for example.

sortOrder.description: The sort order for this option in the dropdown. Lower values will render higher in the dropdown.

label.description:
The `label` represents the text that will be shown in the
model selection dropdown for the current model.
